* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Character: Pit Droid, Tatooine, C
|strategy=By [mailto:ecolson@ix.netcom.com Eric Olson]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/pitdroid.html</ref>

This little droid can definitely give you the edge in any podrace. He all but guarantees you will never have to keep any low destiny and ensures your Podracer stays in the lead. If you draw low, you can redraw it right away, and if it's still low, you can try again in your next control phase before you would draw for that turn. He also makes sure your Podracer is never damaged, ensuring that you'll never have to lose force to draw destiny, except for when you're redrawing yours with his other ability.
